GEOGRAPHY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

2. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   C. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   D. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Folding is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Folding.
   B. Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Folding never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Folding as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   C. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.

5. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   C. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   D. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.
   B. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.
   D. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.
   B. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.

8. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

9. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Energy as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.
   D. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Industry is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Industry.
   B. Treat Industry as rumours only.
   C. Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Industry never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Mining as rumours only.
   C. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.

12. Which statement about Vulcanicity is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Vulcanicity never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Vulcanicity as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Vulcanicity.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Vulcanicity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Earthquakes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Agriculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Mining and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
